name: dll-loader-worldmanager
summary: Make WorldManager.exe load the companion hook DLL (fiestahook.dll) before its entry point - the same loader Zone.exe gets.
status: WRITTEN 2026-09-25 (Fiesta2026on2016 Q53: runtime thread counts via the cpu_count plugin).
why: The same loader as dll-loader (read that recipe): one import of fiestahook.dll!ZoneHookInit appended to a
copy of the import descriptors, no code patched. WorldManager.exe has no bound-import directory (checked at apply
time) and imports StartServiceCtrlDispatcherA, where the loader starts its plugins - from WorldManager/hooks/, a folder
of its own. With an empty hooks/ the exe runs exactly as before.
